source.title: Numerical and asymptotic analysis of the 't Hooft-Polyakov magnetic monopole
source.version: v2, 24 March 2005 13:12:11 UTC; authenticated with arXiv history and PDF stamp; dynamically rendered cover date is not used as version date
source.result_used: M/M0=1+beta/2+O(beta^2 log beta), M0=4*pi*vF/e, MW=e*vF, beta=MH/MW
source.domain: Classical isolated static unit-charge SU(2) adjoint-Higgs monopole with polynomial Higgs potential, infinite spatial domain, beta tending to zero from above
source.translation: q=e*Phi, e=g, v=e*vF, m=MH; circle action=L*M, kappa=L/g^2. Therefore L*M0*beta/2=2*pi*kappa*m.
checks_performed: Action normalization and linear coefficient extracted
No higher-order coefficient, source numerical fit, or source full solution reproduced
source.implication: verified for the stated classical benchmark; conditional for the double-trace model under REPORT M9 matching assumptions
